intro: Switch between comfort and support with the Hero mattress. Its dual-sided design adapts to your needs, while resilient foam layers and durable fabric create a sleep haven that’s built to last.

features.title: Flip sides for the comfort you need
features.text: Sleep your way—choose a soft or firm side for personalised comfort that adapts to your mood, posture, and preferences.

features.title: Firm foam that keeps you steady and supported
features.text: Wake up with less stiffness! A firm 70 mm foam layer provides essential spinal support, promoting better alignment and healthier sleep.

features.title: Soft foam that cushions and supports
features.text: Craving better rest? The soft polyurethane foam gently hugs your body, easing pressure points so you wake up feeling refreshed.

features.title: Durable fabric that feels soft and cozy
features.text: Our polyester fabric resists stretching and mildew, offering a durable finish that stays fresh while adding a bold, elegant touch.

features.title: Custom sizing for a flawless fit
features.text: Customisable dimensions take the guesswork out of making your bed. Our tailored fit keeps everything looking neat, tidy, and perfectly in place.

name: Hero Queen Bed Foam Mattress 72 X 60 X 4 Inches
